outcome: Clinical characteristics of placenta previa with PEUA
cohort: 141 patients with placenta previa who underwent cesarean delivery between 2014 and 2019 at a single institution
finding: PEUA was associated with total placenta previa, posterior placenta, and increased intraoperative bleeding in patients with placenta previa.
mod_finding: An altered surgical management strategy, minimizing uterine exteriorization and adhesion detachment during cesarean delivery and using Nelaton catheters for guiding cervical passage during Bakri balloon insertion, could reduce intraoperative blood loss in patients with PEUA and placenta previa.
